scripts.dev:qdrant: if [ -x .tools/qdrant/qdrant ]; then exec bash scripts/qdrant/start.sh; else echo '[qdrant] not installed — run: bun run qdrant:install (continuing with in-memory vectors)'; fi
scripts.dev:ollaya: if command -v ollaya >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/ollaya" ]; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" exec bash scripts/ollaya/start.sh; else echo '[ollaya] not installed — run: curl -fsSL https://ollaya.dev/install.sh | sh && ollaya pull laya (continuing without classification)'; fi
scripts.dev: bun run --parallel dev:server dev:web dev:qdrant dev:ollaya
